# robinhood-chain-examples

> Runnable code examples for building on Robinhood Chain: SDK snippets, live price tickers, firehose consumers, agent scripts.

robinhood-chain-examples is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/robinhood-chain-examples/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference

- [Which package do I need?](https://github.com/nirholas/robinhood-chain-examples/blob/HEAD/README.md#which-package-do-i-need)
